scope: Constructed action-space counterexample after exploratory enumeration; neither preregistered discovery nor evidence of a GNN win
physics: Two jobs of two operations, two eligible hosts per operation, setup type zero throughout, distinct per-job locks, two-host power domain with capacity two
objective: Sum of both job completion times
nondelay_certificate: Enumerate all 16 placements times all 24 operation-priority permutations; native and independent SimPy must agree for every plan
unrestricted_certificate: Enumerate every placement and per-host operation sequence; reject cycles with job precedence and compute earliest starts in each remaining DAG. Under this fixture's nonbinding extra constraints, this covers an optimal nonpreemptive schedule.
live_gate: Four runs: best historical non-delay plan, zero-reservation parity, certified reservation schedule, simple hand reservation. Audit all operation times and assignments.
hand_control: Reserve host zero until the short job's second operation has completed at time six; defer only the long job's first operation
claim_limit: A witness refutes completeness of the old action space, not effectiveness of a trained GNN. The hand reservation may tie the certified optimum.
